'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Crimea attacks (2022–present)|Crimea attacks]]
***[[June 2024 Sevastopol missile attack]]
****[[Armed Forces of Ukraine|Ukrainian forces]] launch an [[ATACMS]] missile bombardment on [[Sevastopol]], [[Crimea]], with missile fragments hitting a beach, killing five people and injuring at least 153 others of which 27 were children. [[Russia]]'s [[Russian Ministry of Defense|ministry of defense]] says that it holds the [[United States]] responsible for the attack and vows that there will be a response. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russia-says-three-killed-nearly-100-wounded-ukrainian-atacms-attack-crimea-2024-06-23/ (Reuters)]
**[[Kharkiv strikes (2022–present)|Kharkiv strikes]]
***One person is killed and ten others are injured in [[Russian Armed Forces|Russian]] strikes on [[civilian]] infrastructure in [[Kharkiv]], [[Ukraine]]. [https://www.reuters.com/business/aerospace-defense/one-killed-ten-wounded-by-russian-strikes-kharkiv-official-says-2024-06-23/ (Reuters)]
*[[Israel–Hamas war]]
**[[Israeli invasion of the Gaza Strip (2023–present)|Israeli invasion of the Gaza Strip]]
***Eight [[Palestinians]] are killed in [[IDF]] airstrikes that hit a [[UNRWA]]-run vocational college in [[Gaza City]] that was being used to distribute aid. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/israeli-tanks-edge-rafahs-mawasi-refuge-zone-residents-say-2024-06-23/ (Reuters)]
*[[2024 Dagestan attack]]
**At least 16 people are killed and 13 others are injured in [[Dagestan]], [[Russia]], when gunmen [[mass shooting|open fire]] on a [[synagogue]] and an [[Eastern Orthodoxy|Orthodox]] church in [[Derbent]] and on a traffic police post in [[Makhachkala]]. [https://english.alarabiya.net/News/world/2024/06/23/gunmen-attack-synagogue-in-russia-s-north-caucasus-one-police-officer-killed (Al Arabiya)] [https://www.rbc.ru/society/23/06/2024/6678445c9a794781777cad91 (RBK)]
*[[Israel–Hezbollah conflict (2023–present)|Israel–Hezbollah conflict]]
**[[North Macedonia|North Macedonia's]] [[Ministry of Foreign Affairs (North Macedonia)|Ministry of Foreign Affairs]] urges all its citizens in [[Lebanon]] to leave as soon as possible due to "deteriorating security" in the region from escalating conflicts. [https://www.slobodenpecat.mk/en/mnr-apelira-nashite-drzhavjani-da-go-napushtat-liban-mozhe-da-se-vloshi-situacijata/ (''Sloboden Pečat'')]
*[[Red Sea crisis]]
**The [[Houthis]] claim to have carried out a joint military operation with the [[Islamic Resistance in Iraq]] to target four vessels in the [[Port of Haifa]], [[Israel]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/6/23/yemens-houthis-claim-joint-raid-on-israeli-ships-with-iraqi-militia (Al Jazeera)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2024 Hajj disaster]]
**The [[Saudi Arabia|Saudi]] health minister announces that 1,301 people are now confirmed to have died during this year's [[Hajj]] pilgrimage. [https://english.alarabiya.net/News/saudi-arabia/2024/06/23/saudi-health-minister-says-1-301-died-during-hajj  (Al Arabiya)]
*One person is found dead after floods in southern [[Switzerland]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/one-person-found-dead-after-swiss-floods-2024-06-23/ (Reuters)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[Israel–Hamas war]]
**[[Israel–Hamas war protests in Israel]]
***More than 150,000 [[Israelis]] rally and march in [[Tel Aviv]] to protest against [[Prime Minister of Israel|Prime Minister]] [[Benjamin Netanyahu]] and [[Thirty-seventh government of Israel|his government]], calling for [[Next Israeli legislative election|new elections]], the return of [[Israel–Hamas war hostage crisis|hostages]], and a [[ceasefire]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/6/22/all-of-the-rats-in-the-knesset-mass-anti-war-protest-in-israel (Al Jazeera)]
*[[2024 New Caledonia unrest]]
**Independence leader Christian Tein and seven other activists are flown to [[France]] for [[pre-trial detention]] after being arrested for inciting violence and riots in [[New Caledonia]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/6/23/new-caledonia-independence-activists-sent-to-france-for-detention (Al Jazeera)]
*On the [[Grand Duke's Official Birthday]], [[Henri, Grand Duke of Luxembourg]] announces that his son and heir [[Guillaume, Hereditary Grand Duke of Luxembourg|Guillaume]] will assume royal duties beginning in October, in preparation for Henri's eventual [[abdication]]. [https://www.luxtimes.lu/luxembourg/grand-duke-paves-way-for-abdication-with-surprise-announcement/14509987.html (''Luxembourg Times'')]
